issues.title: test: reject missing production CSS in smoke (PR-01 F01)
issues.body:
Fixes the test-infrastructure defect **F01 / P2** from [independent review #2](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/pull/2): Vite preview returns HTML with HTTP 200 for a missing bundled stylesheet, so the old smoke incorrectly passed an unstyled app.

The production smoke now discovers local stylesheet links, checks actual browser response status/CSS MIME and parsed enabled sheets, then checks stable applied styles (body reset, root overflow, header flex layout). The real application, offline network boundary, model/comparison interactions, local-resource failures and fatal-JavaScript checks remain active. No hashed build filename or external resource is required.

A disposable-build control runner executes the same smoke and is now required in CI. Intact builds pass before and after controls. Missing CSS/HTML fallback, removed links, empty CSS, unrelated nonempty CSS and injected fatal JavaScript must fail specifically at the intended assertion; unrelated setup failures do not satisfy a control.

## Source binding and scope

- Base: `main` at `7b813beeebfa3ded90aacda3d69dab76a5ea991d`, tree `85c621486eafb7eb2bdf95189fc89c059ba7dc83`.
- Head: `fix/pr01-css-smoke-validation` at `accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898`.
- Head tree: `027d88998218c98966f95db7bbe1362e6703009c`; sole parent is the verified base.
- Remote branch was fetched and its tree matched the locally staged tree exactly.
- Preflight confirmed only evidence PR #2 was open and no competing fix branch existed.
- No changes to `src/`, product HTML, dependencies/lockfile, Playwright configuration, or lint exceptions. PR #1/#2 branches and historical evidence are untouched.
- [Implementation report and reproducible evidence](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898/docs/verification/pr01-f01-css-smoke/REPORT.md); [command exits](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898/docs/verification/pr01-f01-css-smoke/logs/checks.json); [verified file bindings](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898/docs/verification/pr01-f01-css-smoke/logs/source-bindings.json).

## Reproduction and local results

The exact original review probes were executed against the original reviewed product: missing CSS produced HTTP 200 `text/html`, zero rules, default 8px body margin and no page errors; the unchanged original smoke exited **0 / one passed**. The original negative harness exited 1 because this coverage expectation was unmet. This is F01 reproduction, not a failed ordinary CI run.

On the corrected files, clean `npm ci --cache /tmp/vision-edge-npm-cache`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` (3 files / 8 tests), `npm run build`, normal Chromium `npm run test:e2e`, `npm run test:e2e:controls`, and `git diff --check` all exited **0**. Browser commands used `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium`.

Control child exits: intact **0**, missing CSS/HTML fallback **1** (MIME), absent link **1** (link count), empty CSS **1** (parsed rules), unrelated CSS **1** (applied style), fatal JavaScript **1** (existing pageErrors assertion), intact after controls **0**. The control runner exits **0** when these expected results occur.

Linux x86_64, Node **24.19.0**, npm **11.9.0**, Playwright **1.64.1**, local system Chromium **154.0.8037.57**. Local matched-browser download exited 1 with HTTP 403 `Domain forbidden`; these local results are not matched-browser claims. A fresh detached checkout of exact published HEAD `accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898`, tree `027d88998218c98966f95db7bbe1362e6703009c`, reran the full clean installation/static/unit/build/smoke/control sequence: **all commands exited 0**, eight unit/component tests passed, all seven control outcomes matched, and final `git status --porcelain` was empty. Every verified file blob and every built-file SHA-256 matched the committed evidence manifest. The exact-head run installed dependencies before querying the local Playwright version.

## Hosted CI

[CI run 40050196050](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40050196050), [verify job 120740948261](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40050196050/job/120740948261): **completed / success**, terminal run updated **2026-10-24 01:33:03 UTC**, exact HEAD `accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898`. The exact-commit check-run API also reports `verify` completed/success. All steps succeeded, including clean locked installation, typecheck, ESLint, 3 files / 8 unit/component tests, production build, matched Chromium install, normal smoke, **Stylesheet smoke controls**, artifact upload and cleanup.

Downloaded job logs confirm checkout of that exact SHA, Node **24.19.0**, npm **11.17.0**, matched Chromium / headless shell **v1248 (Chrome 156.0.8078.4)**, one ordinary smoke pass, both intact control passes and the five intended negative child failures. The control runner and hosted job exited successfully; expected negative child exits 1 are not failed CI. No local system-browser override was used in hosted CI.

## Independent handoff and limits

Keep Draft. A separate non-Author reviewer must verify this exact head/tree and base ancestry, inspect the scoped diff, rerun clean checks/controls, independently apply the original missing-href mutation to the corrected build/smoke and confirm CSS-specific failure plus healthy offline success, and confirm terminal hosted CI includes the controls on this exact head. The original review harness archives the frozen old source; applying its mutation to corrected source is the relevant re-review. This Author has not launched or self-declared independent acceptance.

Windows/macOS, real camera/model/GPU inference, tracking/geometry/FPS, audible/full TTS, broad accessibility and deployment equivalence remain unverified. F02–F05 stay in their recorded scope. No main merge, auto-merge, deployment, release, branch-protection changes or PR-02/03 implementation is authorized here.

issues.title: review: PR-01 foundation — PASS WITH CONDITIONS
issues.body:
Independent non-Author review of PR #1: **PASS WITH CONDITIONS**. The clean foundation checks pass, but **F01 (P2)** must be corrected and independently reverified before PR-01 final acceptance or PR-02 start.

The unchanged production smoke passes after its required bundled stylesheet is replaced with a missing URL. Vite returns HTML 200; the stylesheet has zero rules and the app loses its styling. The smoke checks HTTP >=400/request failures and uncaught JavaScript, but misses this case. This PR publishes findings and reproducible isolated probes; it does not repair implementation.

- [REPORT.md](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/67e0c15e652d88c773a82b06f615b2befa27a695/docs/verification/pr01-independent-review/REPORT.md)
- [findings.json](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/67e0c15e652d88c773a82b06f615b2befa27a695/docs/verification/pr01-independent-review/findings.json)
- [Evidence index and reproduction](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/67e0c15e652d88c773a82b06f615b2befa27a695/docs/verification/pr01-independent-review/INDEX.md)

No P0/P1 finding. F02 is the bounded lint-exception blind spot; F03 dictionary, F04 capability/backend truthfulness, and F05 camera lifecycle are inherited, documented deferrals. Full contracts, locations, impact and acceptance conditions are in the register.

## Source and publication binding

- Base branch: `chore/build-ci-test-foundation`
- Reviewed source / direct parent: `f20474be156522ee6141cde9c2b3a958db8d2457`
- Reviewed source tree: `85c621486eafb7eb2bdf95189fc89c059ba7dc83`
- Frozen pre-review main: `90323c00a6cd9a8157bf3eec853dbe5a857f07a1`
- Review branch: `review/pr01-build-ci-test-foundation`
- Evidence HEAD: `67e0c15e652d88c773a82b06f615b2befa27a695`
- Evidence tree: `328519ed7bcba68ca303173f5e7bb608c4371365`

Only the new `docs/verification/pr01-independent-review/` directory is added. Existing product source, tests, CI and accepted evidence are preserved. Preflight found no target movement, prior reviews or duplicate review PR.

## Validation

Exact-source clean detached checkout, Node 24.19.0/npm 11.9.0/Linux: npm ci, npm ls --all, typecheck, ESLint, 8 tests, production build and one production smoke all pass; final Git status clean. Baseline esbuild/Vite ERESOLVE was reproduced. Dev/clean/ignore/lock checks pass. Type/lint/service/UI/uncaught-error negative controls fail as expected; required CSS loss unexpectedly passes (F01). Base/target synthetic engine and dictionary outputs match.

Original product [CI run 40047953579](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40047953579), [job 120733858384](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40047953579/job/120733858384): completed/success on exact reviewed source SHA. API metadata and downloaded logs independently confirm checkout, all steps, Node 24.19.0/npm 11.17.0 and matched Chromium v1248 installation/smoke.

Evidence-PR [CI run 40049310581](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40049310581), [job 120738153472](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40049310581/job/120738153472): **completed/success at 2026-10-24 01:20:59 UTC**, exact evidence HEAD `67e0c15e652d88c773a82b06f615b2befa27a695`. Every verification step succeeded. Downloaded logs confirm exact checkout, Node 24.19.0/npm 11.17.0, 8 tests, matched Chromium v1248 installation and one production smoke pass. This is separate from original product CI and does **not** resolve F01; CI does not execute the independent negative-control scripts.

Final remote receipt: the review branch still points to `67e0c15e652d88c773a82b06f615b2befa27a695`, tree `328519ed7bcba68ca303173f5e7bb608c4371365`, with sole parent `f20474be156522ee6141cde9c2b3a958db8d2457`. Comparing source and accepted evidence outside the new directory returns no differences.

## Limits and boundaries

Local matched browser download returned HTTP 403; local smoke used system Chromium 154. Hosted original CI installed matched Chrome 156 successfully. Real camera/device/GPU/model inference, accuracy/geometry/FPS, audible/full TTS, broad accessibility, Windows/macOS and deployment/source equivalence remain unverified. Foundation review is not whole-app acceptance.

Keep this review PR Draft. No merge, release, deploy, ruleset/branch-protection change, PR #1 modification or PR-02/03 implementation was performed by this reviewer.

## Post-publication source-state observation

During publication, PR #1 was merged externally at **2026-10-24 01:19:46 UTC**. Main is now `7b813beeebfa3ded90aacda3d69dab76a5ea991d`, whose tree is exactly `85c621486eafb7eb2bdf95189fc89c059ba7dc83`, identical to the frozen reviewed source. The Author branch remains `f20474be156522ee6141cde9c2b3a958db8d2457`. This reviewer neither requested nor performed that merge. REPORT.md preserves the review-time snapshot and requested gates. F01 remains unresolved on the merged tree; the condition before PR-02 still applies. The review PR remains directly based on the requested Author branch.

The external merge also triggered main-push [CI run 40049286165](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40049286165), [job 120738075419](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40049286165/job/120738075419): **completed/success** on `7b813beeebfa3ded90aacda3d69dab76a5ea991d`, all steps successful. This post-report observation supplies actual main-push evidence; it was not triggered by the reviewer. No action was denied or left with an uncertain publication outcome. Remaining implementation condition: F01.

issues.title: chore: establish reproducible build, lint, test and CI infrastructure
issues.body:
## Summary

Establish PR-01's repeatable install, static checks, offline tests, production build and pull-request CI, starting from main `90323c00a6cd9a8157bf3eec853dbe5a857f07a1`.

## Changes

- Reproduced baseline ERESOLVE (Vite 8.3.5 optional peer esbuild ^0.27.0 || ^0.28.0 versus direct ^0.25.0); removed the unused direct esbuild dependency and committed npm lockfile v3. No force or legacy peer resolution.
- Retained existing Vite/React ranges. Pinned MediaPipe SDK 0.10.14 to the existing WASM URL. Used TypeScript ~6.0.3 because current typescript-eslint supports >=4.8.4 <6.1.0; the original ^7.0.2 is unsupported by that parser.
- Added Node 24.19.0 / npm 11 requirements, actual ESLint with TypeScript and React Hooks checks, separate TypeScript checking, non-watch Vitest/RTL tests, and production-preview Playwright smoke.
- Added cross-platform Node-based clean, generated/local/secret-file ignore rules, README and committed verification evidence.
- Pinned checkout v7.0.1, setup-node v7.1.0, and upload-artifact v7.0.2 to verified commit SHAs with native Node 24 runtimes, eliminating the initial run's action-runtime deprecation warning.
- Added CI on pull requests and pushes to main: locked install → typecheck → ESLint → unit/component tests → build → Chromium install → browser smoke, with reports uploaded for 14 days and no application secrets.
- Product changes are unused bindings/imports/parameters and an overwritten array initializer only. Vite config uses ESM import.meta.dirname. One existing render-loop exhaustive-deps exception is documented to preserve current scheduling behavior.

## Verification commands/results

Selected Linux cloud environment, Node v24.19.0, npm 11.9.0:
- `npm ci`: exit 0, 265 packages, no resolver overrides.
- `npm run typecheck`: exit 0.
- `npm run lint`: exit 0, zero warnings.
- `npm test`: exit 0, 3 files / 8 tests.
- `npm run build`: exit 0, production output generated.
- `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium npm run test:e2e`: exit 0, 1 smoke test using system Chromium 154.0.8037.57.
- `npm run dev -- --strictPort`: HTTP 200 with source entrypoint.
- `npm run clean` twice: exit 0, outputs absent afterward.
- `npm ls`, `git diff --check`, ignore-rule probes: successful.

Committed evidence: [verification record](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/f20474be156522ee6141cde9c2b3a958db8d2457/docs/verification/pr01.md), [command output](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/f20474be156522ee6141cde9c2b3a958db8d2457/docs/verification/pr01-local-verification.txt), [baseline failure](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/f20474be156522ee6141cde9c2b3a958db8d2457/docs/verification/pr01-baseline-install.txt).

## CI Results

Final head commit: `f20474be156522ee6141cde9c2b3a958db8d2457`, verified on the remote branch. Main remains `90323c00a6cd9a8157bf3eec853dbe5a857f07a1`.

- Final [CI run #2](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40047953579) completed with conclusion **success** at 2026-10-24 01:03:32 UTC on this exact SHA. The [verify job](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40047953579/job/120733858384) and every step completed successfully: locked install, TypeScript, ESLint, 8 unit/component tests, production build, Playwright Chromium installation, 1 browser smoke test, and artifact upload.
- Run metadata and checkout logs confirm the final SHA. Hosted runtime: Ubuntu 24.04, Node 24.19.0, npm 11.17.0, Playwright Chromium v1248 / Chrome 156.0.8078.4. No action-runtime deprecation warning remains.
- [Final Playwright report artifact](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40047953579/artifacts/12542037831), retained until 2026-11-07.
- The earlier [CI run #1](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40047719630) also succeeded; its deprecated v4 action runtimes prompted the final SHA-pinned Node 24 action update.
- The entire local install/typecheck/lint/unit/build/smoke sequence was rerun successfully on the final commit (npm 11.9.0, system Chromium 154). This is separate from the hosted evidence above.

## Known Limitations

- Local Playwright browser download received HTTP 403 `Domain forbidden` from cdn.playwright.dev (Chromium v1248 / Chrome 156.0.8078.4). Local smoke used the explicit system-Chromium override; hosted CI successfully installed and ran its matched browser; the local download restriction did not affect hosted CI.
- Unit App tests mock the external MediaPipe loader, deny camera permission and use a null canvas context. Browser smoke executes real local production HTML/CSS/JS, denies camera permission and blocks all external requests (including model/WASM/font resources); it checks rendering, controls and uncaught errors, not inference.
- Real camera/device/GPU/model behavior, accuracy, tracking/geometry, FPS semantics, actual TTS playback and broad accessibility are untested. Windows/macOS were not executed; clean portability is reasoned from Node filesystem APIs.
- **Dictionary (observed):** `getLabelInfo('carpet')` yields the car translation through substring matching; `typeof getLabelInfo('constructor')` is `function` through inherited properties. Deferred to PR-06; tests do not encode those defects as correct behavior.
- **Model/backend claims (source-confirmed):** selecting YOLO-seg/SegFormer still routes through MediaPipe ObjectDetector plus generated polygons; backend selection changes labels while initialization requests the GPU delegate. Deferred to PR-02.
- **Camera lifecycle (source-confirmed, not device-verified):** with camera active, a parent re-render (e.g. model selection) changes inline `onCameraStop`, restarting the webcam effect; late acquisition lacks a cancellation guard. Deferred to PR-03.
- **Overlay closure (source-confirmed, not device-verified):** tap an already-selected detection without changing the effect's other dependencies; the render loop may retain old clickRipple. A single targeted exhaustive-deps exception preserves existing loop restart behavior for PR-04/06 review. No global lint rule is disabled.

## Next Steps

Independent review of PR-01, including the final hosted CI evidence and narrow lint exception. No hosted CI blocker remains. PR-02 can proceed after that independent review. No later roadmap phase has been implemented or certified. Keep this PR as Draft; no deployment, merge, release, ruleset or branch-protection changes.
